events.label: Became Earl of Wessex
events.note: Cnut elevated Godwin to the earldom of Wessex, making him one of the most powerful magnates in England.

events.label: Marriage to Gytha Thorkelsdóttir
events.labelCn: 与吉莎·索凯尔斯多蒂尔结婚
events.note: The marriage date is uncertain; Gytha was of Danish aristocratic descent and became mother of Harold Godwinson and his siblings.

events.label: Supported Harthacnut's claim after Cnut's death
events.labelCn: 克努特去世后支持哈德克努特的继承权
events.note: Godwin was central to the contest between Harthacnut and Harold Harefoot after Cnut died.

events.label: Backed Harthacnut's accession
events.note: Godwin helped secure Harthacnut's return and accession as king of England.

events.label: Supported Edward the Confessor's accession
events.labelCn: 支持忏悔者爱德华即位
events.note: Godwin remained indispensable when Edward succeeded Harthacnut, beginning the political dominance of the Godwin family under Edward.

events.label: Daughter Edith married King Edward
events.labelCn: 女儿伊迪丝嫁给爱德华国王
events.note: The marriage linked the royal house to the Godwin family, though it produced no children.

events.label: Exiled from England
events.note: After refusing Edward's order to punish Dover, Godwin and his family were outlawed and fled England.

events.label: Returned and restored to power
events.note: Godwin returned with an armed fleet; Edward accepted a settlement and restored the family to its estates and offices.

events.label: Death of Godwin, Earl of Wessex
events.labelCn: 威塞克斯伯爵戈德温去世
events.note: He died at Winchester after collapsing during a royal gathering; later stories vary, and the precise medical cause is unknown.

sourceNote: The date and place of Godwin's birth are uncertain; c. 990 and Sussex are conventional approximations. His political rise under Cnut and restoration in 1052 are well attested.
notes: Father of Harold Godwinson. Gytha and the other Godwin children are not yet in the roster; the father-son UUID link is deliberately limited to the verified existing card.

deathCause.summary: Collapsed and died; medical cause is not securely recorded
deathCause.summaryCn: 昏倒后去世，确切病因无可靠记载
deathCause.detail: Godwin collapsed during a royal gathering at Winchester and died soon afterwards on 15 April 1053. Later accounts attach dramatic details to the episode, but no contemporary medical diagnosis survives.
deathCause.detailCn: 1053年4月15日，戈德温在温彻斯特的一次王室集会上昏倒后不久去世。后世叙述增添了戏剧性细节，但没有可靠的当代医学记录。

events.label: Became Earl of East Anglia
events.note: Harold first appears as earl in the mid-1040s; the precise initial territorial allocation is reconstructed from later evidence.

events.label: Exiled with the Godwin family
events.labelCn: 随戈德温家族被逐出英格兰
events.note: Harold left England with his father after the crisis between Godwin and Edward the Confessor.

events.label: Returned with Godwin and restored
events.labelCn: 随戈德温返回并恢复地位
events.note: The negotiated restoration of the Godwins returned Harold to political prominence.

events.label: Succeeded as Earl of Wessex
events.note: After Godwin's death, Harold inherited Wessex and became the most powerful lay magnate in England.

events.label: Shipwreck and oath in Normandy (traditional account)
events.labelCn: 在诺曼底遇难并宣誓（传统叙述）
events.note: Norman sources place Harold in Normandy and say he swore to support William's claim; the date, circumstances and legal meaning remain disputed.

events.label: Death of Edward the Confessor
events.note: Edward's death opened the succession crisis in which Harold, William of Normandy and Harald Hardrada all advanced claims.

events.label: Crowned King of the English
events.labelCn: 加冕为英格兰人的国王
events.note: The English sources associate Harold's coronation with Westminster on the day after Edward's death.

events.label: Battle of Stamford Bridge
events.note: Harold defeated Harald Hardrada and his brother Tostig in Yorkshire, then marched south to meet William.

events.label: Battle of Hastings and death
events.note: Harold was killed while commanding the English army, reportedly struck in the eye by an arrow. The battle ended his kingship and opened the Norman conquest.
events.noteCn: 哈罗德统率英格兰军队作战时阵亡；据说一箭射中其眼部。此战终结了他的王位，并开启诺曼征服。

sourceNote: Harold's birth year and several details of his Norman voyage are uncertain. His accession, Stamford Bridge and death at Hastings are securely dated.
notes: Son of Godwin, Earl of Wessex. Edward the Confessor is his predecessor in the title chain, not his parent; no false genealogical edge is created. His wives/partners and children are outside the current roster.

deathCause.summaryCn: 在黑斯廷斯战役中战死
deathCause.detail: Harold died fighting William of Normandy's army on 14 October 1066, reportedly after an arrow struck his eye.
deathCause.detailCn: 1066年10月14日，哈罗德在与诺曼底威廉军队作战时阵亡；据说一箭射中其眼部。
deathCause.culprit: Army of William, Duke of Normandy
deathCause.culpritCn: 诺曼底公爵威廉的军队
